title: Machine-readable CDE dictionary v0.1 (definitions, value sets, units, provenance)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Hee-Lee Oss never holds patient data. The machine-readable CDE dictionary is the single source of truth for definitions, value sets, units, and provenance that the schema, profiles, and validators are generated from (depends on modules-011). It binds terminologies by reference only and embeds no terminology content. Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Author CDE dictionary v0.1 as machine-readable data with full provenance and value-set bindings for all core CDEs.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% of core CDEs have id/label/definition/dataType/value-set + provenance block (source/url/accessedDate/version/license)
